name: ENGENT
old_description: Engent is a provider of next generation electronic manufacturing and technology services. Engent leverages its world-class facilities, highly experienced and educated team to provide solutions to a sophisticated client base which shorten a product’s time to market and which enable products to be manufactured at high volumes.
about:
Engent, Inc. operates from Norcross, Georgia. The company was founded by Matt Perry, who serves as managing director, while Daniel F. Baldwin holds the title of president. Additional leadership includes Giorgos Hatzilias as business unit manager and John Keller as plant manager.

The firm provides advanced electronic research, manufacturing, and development services. Its capabilities span advanced assembly, electronics production, design support, and analytical, reliability, and failure testing. Engent describes its facilities as world-class but does not disclose square footage, headcount, or annual volume.

Engent serves the technology industry, targeting sophisticated clients that need accelerated time to market and high-volume production. A notable transaction includes the acquisition of rights to the Siemens Dematic Advanced Assembly Technology Center from Siemens Dematic Electronics Assembly Systems, Inc. The company also references involvement in industry reliability programs with organizations such as IPC, Solectron, Flextronics, and U.S. NAVSEA.

Engent states that its broad service suite—extending beyond assembly into design support and testing—allows it to shorten product development cycles and enable robust, high-volume manufacturing.
